purpose: Run PALACE numerical evidence generation and independent Worldshepherd blocker-closure work concurrently wherever they do not contend for the live solver state or misclassify internal numerical evidence as external validation.

allowed_from_repo_lane: ingest copied or snapshotted terminal outputs read-only
calculate provisional convergence only from explicit completed medium/fine pairs
retain failed, timeout and nonconverged records
prepare VNA/cross-solver/correlation tooling without launching competing live solver work
prohibited_without_explicit_operator_dir: write into or clean the live output tree
renumber or infer completed anchors from checkpoint count
launch a second local Palace workload that may contend with the active run
promote partial numerical results to physical, partner, independent or qualified evidence

parallel_development_lanes.effect: Allows completed anchor copies to be hashed and evaluated while the remaining live anchors continue.
Keep frozen reference-plane, repeatability, complex-S11 and uncertainty gates ready so measurement can begin without waiting for new analysis design after Palace convergence.
Prepare MEEP/FDTD comparator inputs and provenance mapping, but do not treat cross-solver agreement as measurement or independent physical validation.
Continue bounded partner-test preparation and warm-route development independently of Palace compute.
Seek blinded lawful external corpus/evaluator while Palace runs; no dependency on RF compute.
Continue conventional instrumented partner-test preparation while preserving separation from Palace RF numerical evidence.
Freeze pre-outcome predictions and bounded commercial evidence contracts without consuming Palace runtime resources.
